project_type: Python library (skyeai, import package `skye`) built for serverless; Clean Architecture with components in 4 layers behind Ports in skye.base.interfaces
language: Python 3.10+ (target-version py310); modern hints list[str], X | None; dataclasses not pydantic for new user-facing shapes
build_system: uv (uv sync). Run everything through uv; never plain python/pip/pytest. Package layout: src/skye (hatch wheel packages=['src/skye']).
test_framework: pytest (uv run pytest). asyncio_mode=auto. addopts skip the 'budget' marker by default.
verification_instructions: After creating/editing any example: (1) uv run pytest tests/examples -q must pass (it auto-discovers every examples/**/*.py except __init__.py, runs it offline via runpy with run_name='__main__', keys from DUMMY_ENV, HTTP answered by tests/examples/fake_network.py). An example is treated as FAILED if its stdout/stderr contains a line with any FAILURE_MARKER ('❌', '✗', 'Traceback', 'ProviderError:', 'ConfigurationError:', 'ValidationError:', 'AttributeError', 'TypeError', 'KeyError') UNLESS that same line also contains the word 'Expected'. So never print those markers on a normal path; a deliberately-shown error line must contain 'Expected'. (2) uv run ruff check <new paths> must be clean (lint set E,F,I,N,W,UP: sorted imports, no unused imports). (3) uv run black --check <new paths> must report nothing to reformat (line length 100). IMPORTANT scope caveat: the whole-tree commands `uv run ruff check examples/` and `uv run black --check examples/` FAIL today on pre-existing out-of-scope files (1144 ruff errors, 38 black reformats) and this task must not touch those files; therefore verify ruff/black on the NEW paths only.
environment_constraints: Offline only: tests run against a fake network (tests/examples/fake_network.py) with NO optional/provider libraries installed. These libraries are forbidden at import time and absent at runtime: openai, anthropic, boto3, botocore, google, azure, cohere, redis, psycopg2, httpx, requests, tiktoken, opentelemetry, prometheus_client, numpy, asyncpg, fastmcp, yaml. Any example needing one of these MUST import it lazily inside a try/except (ImportError, MissingExtraError) that prints a short skip note and continues/returns — never a top-level import. The IMDS/metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal) raise URLError in the fake, so do not rely on them. The harness restores ONLY the models ProviderRegistry between scripts (not the agents registry or CapabilityRegistry singleton), so register under script-local names and prefer register_agent_type(..., replace=True) where relevant.
contribution_requirements: 00-rules.md: skye.provider(name, **config) with variable named `client` (`embedder` for embeddings) wherever a client is needed (R9.11); dataclasses not pydantic (D24) — steering must never present pydantic as the standard; modern type hints, Google-style docstrings where a public shape is shown; no LangChain-style names (BaseMessage, HumanMessage, Document, Embeddings, OutputParser, Callback); optional/provider libs imported lazily only when the extra is present. Examples are user code and may import top-level skye paths like a user would. Every example is a standalone script with def main() -> None: (or async main + asyncio.run) and if __name__ == '__main__': main(), following examples/basic/quickstart.py (env-var check + early return) and examples/capabilities/local_function.py. README: add a short entry for each new category dir to keep R24.1 satisfied.
key_patterns: Module docstring first; main(); early return + printed skip message when a prerequisite (env var / extra / unimplemented src API) is absent; guard optional imports with try/except. For 'proposed-interface, guarded' examples (API not in src yet): top-of-file docstring states it targets the planned API, show the intended call shape built from REAL Ports/dataclasses, and guard-return before any not-yet-existing call so the script stays green. Record in each file's docstring whether it is 'Live' or 'proposed-interface, guarded'. Study these existing files for house style: examples/basic/quickstart.py, examples/providers/bring_your_own_adapter.py, examples/advanced/custom_providers.py, examples/capabilities/local_function.py, examples/capabilities/mcp_client.py.
directory_structure: examples/ has one dir per area (basic, capabilities, providers, routing, advanced, serverless, prompts) each with a README.md; this task adds base/, models/, auth/, store/, memory/, guard/, policy/, observe/, gateway/, agents/, teams/, flows/ and three files under the existing tools/ area (new dir examples/tools/). src/skye has components base (layer 0), auth (0), models (1), store (1), router (2), tools (2), prompts (2), memory/guard/policy/observe (2, minimal), gateway/agents/teams/flows (3, minimal). Ports live in src/skye/base/interfaces/. The plan with full per-file Digest is at .agents/tasks/example-coverage/plan.md.
